subject: Index of reference-data/Recordings before source videos and screenshots were removed
note: The recordings folder is not in the repository. This index keeps each file's size, SHA-256 and video properties, and names the still kept for it. Stills are local only, under reference-data/Recordings/_stills/ (same folder tree): one contact sheet per video (10 to 30 evenly spaced frames, 640 px wide, five per row, at the times in sheetTimesS) and one JPEG per screenshot; CSV files are copied unchanged. A contact sheet shows setup and content; it cannot be re-measured. Measurements are in the documents listed per folder. The 19 November clips have their own receipt (semi-auto-match-trigger-2026-11-19.md).
